title_or_table: American Community Survey 1-year estimates, Table B25003, Tenure
geography: 50 states and DC, with a United States row (code US)
universe_or_base: Occupied housing units (households), by whether the household owns or rents its home
unit: households in housing units, with 90 percent margins of error; owner_pct and renter_pct are computed by the studio from the counts and stored to four decimals, so a chart rounds once; households_moe is the published margin of the households total, and owner_pct_moe and renter_pct_moe are the shares’ 90 percent margins in percentage points, computed by the studio by the Census Bureau’s formula for a proportion and stored to four decimals
qualification: Survey estimates; shares near 50 percent should be compared using the margins of error before a chart calls a state mostly renters or mostly owners

code.description: USPS state code, US for the nation

owner_pct.description: owners as a percent of households, computed

renter_pct.description: renters as a percent of households, computed

households_moe.description: 90 percent margin of error of the households total (B25003_001M), as published

owner_pct_moe.description: 90 percent margin of error of owner_pct, computed from the published counts and margins by the Census Bureau’s formula for a proportion

renter_pct_moe.description: 90 percent margin of error of renter_pct, computed from the published counts and margins by the Census Bureau’s formula for a proportion

printed_source_line: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 1-year estimates, Table B25003, tenure, 2025, 50 states and DC. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Survey estimates; shares computed by Oath & Action from the table’s counts.

source_line_variants.with_margin: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 1-year estimates, Table B25003, tenure, 2025, 50 states and DC. Retrieved November 11 and 12, 2026. Survey estimates; shares and their 90 percent margins of error computed by Oath & Action from the table’s counts and margins.

notes: Margins of the shares (statistics review S5; data lead ruling RF-11), November 12, 2026: households_moe is B25003_001M from the same ACS 2025 1-year table, read from the Census Bureau’s API (https://api.census.gov/data/2025/acs/acs1?get=NAME,group(B25003)&for=state:* and &for=us:1); the same call returned every count and count margin in this file unchanged. owner_pct_moe and renter_pct_moe follow formula (6) for a proportion in the Census Bureau's "Understanding and Using American Community Survey Data: What All Data Users Need to Know" (2020), chapter 8: the share's margin is the square root of (the part's margin squared minus the share squared times the total's margin squared), over the total; "if the value under the square root is negative, then substitute a “plus” for the “minus” sign". The ratio form was needed for 0 of the 104 shares. The District of Columbia’s renter share carries a margin of 1.68 points, New York’s 0.32, California’s 0.30 and the nation’s 0.14.

The Bureau’s Data Profile DP04 (ACS 2025 1-year, lines DP04_0046P and DP04_0047P, read November 12, 2026) prints the same shares to one decimal with margins it computes itself, 0.2 to 1.7 points; every DP04 share equals this file’s share rounded to one decimal, and the largest gap between a DP04 margin and the formula’s is 0.32 points (ME, 0.68 against 1.0). This file keeps the formula’s margins, so each share and its margin come from one table (RF-11).
